card.name: Inside surnames in citation author lists
card.fires_on: Partway through an author's surname in a reference list, just before the initials. It also fires on a digit inside a long number.

modes.label: Surnames in citations
modes.description: The end or middle of an author surname, right before initials in a reference list.
modes.example: Redcay E, Dodell-Feder D, Pear<<row>> MJ, Mavros PL, Kle

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A middle digit in a number such as a current, dose or concentration.
modes.example: /s 350 or 400 1 mL/kg to 2 mL/kg CT Angiography 300, 3<<5>>0, or 400

card.writes: No clear meaning; it nudges toward names or words starting with H or Hel.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of an author's last name in a reference list, and sometimes inside a long number.
